questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The style of teaching at UvA is more dependent on the student, with an expectation that each student comes prepared for the classes. The seminars, and sometimes the lectures, at UCPH are far more text-based, where we work together in class to unpack the text and explore the arguments, insights, and concepts from the author. The lectures at UvA are, as at UCPH, more of an overall introduction to the theme, while the seminars are more focused on student arguments and interpretations of the texts.

questions.answer: Pretty easy. The city has some similarities to Copenhagen and is also more international, making it easy for people to speak English and meet non-locals.

radar.squat

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Ambitious university
- Prepare for a lot of exams. Each course has multiple exams and essays/presentations.
- Really great city, a lot of fun and exciting things to do and see and be a part of

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
